title: Question 15
passage:
Did you leave the courtyard light on for me? I came in through the back door.
A. The back door sticks when the ground gets wet. B. No, it switches itself on when someone walks past. C. I'll check the bulb tomorrow morning.
passageZh:
你有特地幫我開著中庭的燈嗎？我從後門進來。
A. 地面一濕，後門就會卡住。 B. 沒有，有人走過時，燈會自動亮。 C. 我明天早上會檢查燈泡。
